test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the primary aim of the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM)?

options.text: Encouraging foreign investment in urban infrastructure
Reducing urban poverty through skill development and self-employment
Promoting smart cities in Tier-2 towns
Providing subsidised housing to rural workers

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reducing urban poverty through skill development and self-employment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM)** aims to **reduce urban poverty** by providing sustainable livelihood opportunities to the urban poor.
 
• Its focus is on **skill development**, enabling individuals to become employable in various sectors or to establish their own income-generating activities.
 
• The mission works to provide **self-employment opportunities** to urban poor households by creating support mechanisms such as **self-help groups (SHGs)** and other capacity-building initiatives.
 
• It also aims to improve access to **credit and other financial services** for urban poor individuals to establish and grow their small businesses.
 
• Another key aspect is the formation and promotion of **urban poor collectives** to support social and financial inclusion.
 
• The mission is a part of the Government of India's larger goal to achieve **socio-economic upliftment** and **poverty alleviation** in urban areas.
 
• It focuses on integrating marginalized sections like **women, differently-abled individuals**, and other vulnerable groups into mainstream economic activities.
 
• Specific programs under NULM include **employment through skill training and placement (EST&P),** support to urban street vendors, and shelter for urban homeless.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Encouraging foreign investment in urban infrastructure**__

 __
 
• This is not the primary objective of the **National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM)**.
 
• However, the Government of India has other initiatives, such as **Smart Cities Mission** and **Make in India**, that focus on attracting foreign investments to improve urban infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Promoting smart cities in Tier-2 towns**__
 __
 
• While promoting smart cities is an important agenda of the Government of India, this is primarily addressed through the **Smart Cities Mission**, not NULM.
 
• The **Smart Cities Mission** focuses on creating sustainable and citizen-friendly urban spaces using modern technology.
 
 
 
• **Providing subsidised housing to rural workers**__
 
 
• This relates more closely to the **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)** and not the NULM.
 
• **PMAY** is aimed at providing affordable housing to the economically weaker sections in urban and rural areas.
